description: Kindle Voyage (7th generation), stock firmware 5.13.6. A root read-only probe on 2026-11-12 filled the readings that were complete. Not installable: the command line is incomplete, the runtime machine id was not read, and the stock kernel function bodies were not hashed.
supported_zh: Kindle Voyage（第 7 代），固件 5.13.6。eips 和 uname 已从真机读到。这个构建仍不能安装：命令行不完整，运行时机器号和内核函数体还没有。
supported_en: Kindle Voyage (7th generation), firmware 5.13.6. eips and uname were read from a device. This build still cannot be installed: the command line is incomplete, and the runtime machine id and kernel function bodies are not.

partition_table.ro_note: sysfs ro=0 is the block read-only flag. The root filesystem is mounted read-only. Those are not the same fact, and neither one authorizes writing mmcblk0p1 or the boot partitions.

device_probe.proc_version: Linux version 3.0.35-lab126 (builder@eink-builds) (gcc version 4.9.1 (GCC) ) #2 PREEMPT Thu Apr 8 09:39:57 UTC 2021
device_probe.cmdline_filtered: rootwait log_pos_goal=[redacted] console=ttymxc0,115200 root=/dev/mmcblk0p1 ro ip=[redacted] quiet video=mxcepdcfb:E60,bpp=8,x_mem=3M
device_probe.cmdline_withheld: The filtered line is not a handoff command line. log_pos_goal and ip were removed before the report was kept and are not guessed.
device_probe.capacity_note: The owner states the chip is 4 GB and USB shows about 3.3 GB. mmcblk0 is 3959422976 bytes. mmcblk0p4 is 3269459968 bytes. The mounted FAT is 3265167360 bytes total and had 73515008 bytes free. None of these is 3 GB of free space.

source.firmware_note: Official update.bin, magic SP01. No squashfs magic and no plaintext Linux version or eips. The 1f8b bytes at offset 30755 are not a gzip stream. uname, eips and partition geometry were not extracted.
source.mach_types_note: arch/arm/tools/mach-types in the GPL member names mx6sl_wario as 4091. That is a source fact. It is not copied into measured.machine_id and is not sufficient to hand off.
source.phys_offset_note: arch/arm/plat-mxc/include/mach/memory.h defines MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET as 0x80000000 and, under CONFIG_ARCH_MX6, selects MX6_PHYS_OFFSET 0x10000000. board-mx6sl_wario.c (pristine sha256 1091ae64f576d26e51d30949d30a04f53c2e51783b69d167229cce2759d5c563) uses MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET for boot_params. The handoff does not adopt either address.
source.patches_note: On 2026-11-12 every patch under patches/*.patch and patches/android-core/*.patch applied with tools/apply-patch-series.py onto a fresh tree of this member. That is a source result, not a boot.
